_meanings:
.²1 A boundary-line, landmark.
.²2 The parting line of the hair; the hair parted on each side of the head
 so as to leave a line; {#sImantaH keSaveSe, sImAnto'nyaH#} <ls>Sk.</ls> (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>{#BAMga#}</ns>);
 {#sImante ca tvadupagamajaM yatra nIpaM vaDUnAm#} <ls>Me. 67</ls>; <ls>Śi. 8. 69</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 44</ls>.
.²3 A landmark.
.²4 See {#sImantonnayanam#} below; <ls>Y. 1. 11</ls>.

‘parting of the hair’, one of the twelve Saṃskāras
 or purificatory rites observed by women in the fourth, sixth or eighth
 month of their pregnancy.
